style: Premium modern casino slot game art, polished painterly 3D render, rich polished gold with turquoise and deep teal accents, warm African sunset palette of amber, orange and magenta, soft rim lighting, crisp edges, high detail, vibrant, original design, no watermark, no brand logos

concept-sheet.prompt: Game art concept sheet for an original South African savanna-themed video slot called Gilded Savanna, laid out on a neutral dark presentation board: a row of four premium symbols (a majestic lion head, an elephant head, a black rhino head and a cape buffalo head, each inside an ornate round gold medallion set with turquoise gems), a row of five low symbols (the card ranks A, K, Q, J and 10 as chunky carved gold letters with small savanna leaf ornaments, each a different jewel colour: ruby, emerald, sapphire, amethyst, amber), a glowing golden king protea flower as the wild symbol, a lone baobab tree at sunset inside a glowing circular emblem as the scatter symbol, an ornate gold and teal reel frame, and a sunset savanna background with acacia trees
